title: Stellar engine manifest (manifests/engine.manifest.json)
description: How an installation finds its modules, and what it changes in them. Modules describe themselves in <Id>.stellar.module files: the manifest only holds what this installation does differently.

OrchesterVersion.description: The Stellar Orchester (Software Kit) release the manifest was made for

Directories.description: Folders searched, relative to the root of the installation or absolute

Modules.description: One entry per module this installation changes

Enabled.description: false turns the module off without removing it

Path.description: The module folder, absolute or relative to the root. Wins over a discovered folder

Version.description: Replaces the version. Required for a module that exists only as a package
